cay_ranger.text: This is the Blue Iguana Recovery Programme. We hatch them in captivity, raise them for two years, then release them in a protected reserve.
By the early 2000s there were maybe twenty-odd left in the wild. Now it's over a thousand. It's one of the best conservation stories in the Caribbean, and one of the bluest.

cay_azure.text: A big blue iguana regards you from a basking log with an expression of ancient disdain. It is the colour of a swimming-pool and the temperament of a bishop.
